---
name: New skill proposal
about: Propose a new skill to add to the package
labels: new-skill
---

## What the skill does

One or two sentences: what domain knowledge does it encode, and what decisions does it make for the agent?

## When it should trigger

List the kinds of prompts, phrases, or task types that should activate this skill. Be specific — skills tend to under-trigger without explicit triggers.

## Why this belongs here

What production Android / KMP judgment does this carry that a general agent lacks? What is the cost of getting it wrong without the skill?

## Sketch of content

A rough outline of the `SKILL.md` body. What is the workflow? What are the severity tiers or decision rules? What goes in `references/`?

## Have you tested it?

Describe the prompts you used to verify it triggers and that its advice holds up on a real snippet.
